description.value: Three Valley Lake Chateau is a large 200-room lakeside hotel on the Trans-Canada Highway near Revelstoke, set against rugged mountain scenery on the shores of Three Valley Lake. The property features an indoor pool and hot tub, kayak rentals, and on-site restaurant and cafeteria, offering a comfortable full-service stop for cyclists on a long highway stretch. Room types range from standard guest rooms to multi-level specialty suites, most with private balconies or patios overlooking the gardens and lake.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and provides detailed room and amenity information for Three Valley Lake Chateau. The site explicitly states 'Wi-Fi is not available in guest rooms' — a confirmed negative. No mention of bike storage, laundry, or cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the page. On-site restaurant and cafeteria are confirmed, supporting nearby evening food.
concerns: Minor name discrepancy: OSM uses 'Three Valley Lake Chateau' while the website domain is '3valley.com' and the page title reads '3 Valley Lake Chateau', though the body text also uses 'Three Valley Lake Chateau'. Likely a stylistic variant rather than a genuine error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible hotel on a major cycling corridor. Website is live and shows current room inventory and amenities.
